500232.name: Golianovo

500470.name: Lúčnica nad Žitavou

500577.name: Mojmírovce

500640.name: Nové Sady

500704.name: Rišňovce
500704.note: The presidential election 2024 pages (archived and live) list the announcement, voter information, e-mail notices and candidates, but no okrsky notice.

500941.name: Výčapy-Opatovce

500968.name: Zlaté Moravce

501034.name: Bajč
501034.note: The mayor's document for this vote (https://web.archive.org/web/20241003174309/https://www.bajc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/editor/134sk_4.pdf&original=utvorenie%20volebn%C3%BDch%20okrskov.pdf) lists only the 3 okrsky with their polling stations (č. 1 Bajč – Kultúrny dom, č. 2 Chrasť – bývalé pohostinstvo, č. 3 Vlkanovo – Komunitné centrum), no streets or parts; the municipality has 5 parts (Bajč, Chrasť, Kotelnica, Nový Diel, Vlkanovo), so okrsky are fewer than parts and the parts Kotelnica and Nový Diel cannot be assigned from the document; per the rules this is not_found.

501140.name: Hurbanovo

Live site also rate-limited (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

501174.name: Iža
501174.note: Iža's okrsky decisions on its notice board (NR SR 2023 of 23.06.2023, president 2024 of 23.01.2024, EP 2024 of 22.02.2024) only create okrsky 1 and 2, both in the Obecný dom (zasadacia miestnosť / galéria), without saying which addresses vote in which; the register has no streets, so no rules can be written. 501182.name: Kameničná

501239.name: Marcelová

501328.name: Pribeta

501395.name: Bátorove Kosihy
501395.note: The website keeps only 2026 election files; the only okrsky document found (for the municipal elections of October 2026) names 3 okrsky all in the cultural house no. 1263 with no addresses per okrsok, and the village is a single part with no streets, so no rules can be drawn even from it. The Internet Archive (online) holds no okrsky document of this vote (its 2018-2020 captures of the elections page files are candidate lists and voter information).

501573.name: Gabčíkovo

Amadého s VJM, Komenského 1081/1, B budova, different classrooms); it lists no streets, house numbers or parts. Gabčíkovo has a single part and k.ú., so the okrsky cannot be placed by part either (prompt: station-only documents are usable only where okrsky equal parts with stations in different parts). No other document of the city (live elections pages 2020-2026, archived Joomla site 2017-2022) lists the okrsky's streets.

501581.name: Holice
501581.note: The obec's website (www.obecholice.sk -> www.gelle.sk; the old www.holice.sk is a parked domain) keeps on its notice board (current and archive by year 2017-2026) okrsky documents only for the NR SR election of 2023-09-30 and the EP election of 2024-06-08; for this vote it has none (for 2017 only an 'Informácie pre voliča' DOCX, for 2026 referendum items without an okrsky decision). The Internet Archive CDX API timed out and then refused connections for about 15 minutes; the availability API shows only a 2019 homepage capture of gelle.sk, which could not be opened.

501590.name: Horná Potôň
501590.note: Presidential 2024: only voter information (item 308) and e-mail addresses; no okrsky document. The current site's elections section (live and archived records, categories NR SR 2020, NR SR 2023, referendum 2023, prezident 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026) holds only voter information, e-mail addresses and minutes for these votes; the only okrsky document is "N-9-volebné okrsky.doc" of 2022 (3 okrsky, places only), which is another vote's.

501603.name: Horný Bar

The site search for "okrsk" finds only the 2026 notices. The Internet Archive (CDX API) was unreachable at the time, so archived copies could not be checked.

501662.name: Janíky

501719.name: Kútniky

501735.name: Lehnice
501735.note: The municipality (2 okrsky, 5 parts, no streets) publishes no utvorenie volebných okrskov with their territory on its website, live or archived; the presidential election 2024 page gives only e-mail addresses (and the zápisnice).

501743.name: Lúč na Ostrove
501743.note: The obec's Voľby page (live, and as the Internet Archive kept it in 2019 and 2022) has a category "Voľby prezidenta Slovenskej republiky 2024" but no decision on the okrsky and polling stations for this vote: only the announcement of the vote, the e-mail address for delegating commission members, the Ministry's information for voters (generic, no okrsky) and, for elections, candidate lists or commission minutes. The live notice board is empty and none of its archived documents (old e_download.php and data/uredni_deska files, file_storage downloads in the CDX) concerns the okrsky. The only okrsky decision the website has is the one for the municipal and regional elections of 24 October 2026 (download.php?file=4486d01c|545), which is not this vote's. The Internet Archive answered. A web search for the okrsky of Lúč na Ostrove found nothing else.

501808.name: Nový Život
501808.note: The website's pages of the votes (news items 'Voľby …', 'Referendum 2026') link no okrsky document of the 2024 presidential vote (only results, minutes, voter information); the notice board keeps only current items; the only okrsky document on the site is that of the elections of 24 October 2026. The Internet Archive's web.archive.org refused every connection for over 30 minutes (only the availability API answered), so no archived pages or documents could be read.
tried: https://www.novyzivot.sk/evt_file.php?file=2288 … 2330 (unlinked files of spring 2026, by file name)

501824.name: Okoč
501824.note: The 2024 presidential election page has only the information for voters and e-mail addresses; no okrsky document.
tried: https://www.okoc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/uredni_deska/obsah1_1.pdf … obsah400_1.pdf (every file of the notice board, 244 found, none on okrsky)

501859.name: Orechová Potôň

501921.name: Topoľníky

502006.name: Vrakúň

502022.name: Zlaté Klasy

502031.name: Levice
502031.note: The live website's election pages list only results (minutes per okrsok) for this vote, no mayor's okrsky document; the úradná tabuľa (CG eGOV) shows only current postings. The Internet Archive's CDX for levice.sk answered 504/timeouts for most years over ~20 minutes of retries (only 2018 and 2020 lists came back, without okrsky documents); its captures of the old elections pages hold no okrsky notice. The council's obvody resolution of 02.08.2018 lists 47 okrsky but is no document of this vote.

502219.name: Drženice
502219.note: No okrsky document for this vote found: drzenice.sk has no elections section and its live notice board keeps only current notices; the Internet Archive holds few files of the site (opaque download_file_f.php ids). Every archived file captured in the weeks around this vote's okrsky deadline was opened (text or OCR); none is this vote's okrsky notice. Other votes' notices (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, referendum 2026) cannot be used for this vote.

502421.name: Kozárovce
502421.note: No okrsky document for the 2024 presidential election found. 502642.name: Plášťovce
502642.note: The live website has no elections section; its notice board and archive reach back only to spring 2026 and hold no okrsky document. 502693.name: Pukanec

502821.name: Tekovské Lužany

A. Komenského 37, bývalá MŠ Družstevná 87), not which streets vote where; the municipality has a single part, so no okrsok can be inferred from its station. No 2017 or 2018 okrsky document is on the site. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

502863.name: Tlmače

The Internet Archive has no 2023-2024 captures of mestotlmace.sk. The EP 2024 document (same four okrsky as 2022) is another vote's and is not used.

502987.name: Želiezovce

503185.name: Gbelce

503321.name: Lipová

503401.name: Mužla

503550.name: Strekov

Internet Archive was intermittently offline but answered after retries.

503568.name: Svodín

The Internet Archive's captures of the old (WordPress) and new site's election pages and notices (2017, 2018, 2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023) list voters' information, postal vote, e-mail and council-size notices, but no okrsky document, and its CDX of svodin.sk has no okrsky file.

503592.name: Šurany
503592.note: The elections pages list okrsky documents only for the referendums of 2023 and 2026 and the 2026 elections; no okrsky document of the presidential election of 2024 (its page is gone, 404) found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

503614.name: Tvrdošovce

503649.name: Zemné

503711.name: Diakovce
503711.note: The website's elections section has pages only for NR SR 2020 (voter information, e-mail address, call — no okrsky), 2022 and 2026; no okrsky document for this vote. The Internet Archive was flaky/refusing connections during the search.

503746.name: Dolné Saliby

503835.name: Jelka

503959.name: Pata
503959.note: No okrsky notice for this vote: the live election pages (2024 presidential and EP) and every archived elections page of obecpata.sk (2018–2024, captured before the votes) carry only the announcement and voter information, no 'oznámenie o vytvorení volebných okrskov'; the site publishes the okrsky (by súpisné číslo) only on the 2022 and 2026 pages. Another vote's notice is not this vote's.

504025.name: Šaľa

504068.name: Tešedíkovo

Every okrsky document Tešedíkovo published (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) gives each of its 3 okrsky only its polling station (Dom kultúry č. 860; MŠ č. 153; Školská jedáleň ZŠ č. 974), never which houses vote where. The municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so the okrsky cannot be placed or inferred from the stations (the prompt's part-inference needs as many parts as okrsky).

504106.name: Trstice
504106.note: The mayor's 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov v obci Trstice pre voľby prezidenta Slovenskej republiky v roku 2024' (notice-board item 275, dated 30.1.2024, https://www.trstice.sk/e_download.php?file=/data/uredni_deska/obsah275_1.pdf) lists only the 3 okrsky with their polling stations (Okrsok č. 1 Obecný úrad č. 667, č. 2 Komunitný dom č. 1322, č. 3 Základná škola č. 647), no house numbers or territory. Trstice has a single part and no streets (all addresses are súpisné čísla), so a list of polling stations alone cannot be turned into rules (3 okrsky, 1 part). Every item of the official notice board (úradná tabuľa, items 1–444, 2016–2026, incl. the items migrated from the old Joomla site) was listed by id and every election item opened; the Internet Archive (CDX of trstice.sk, old site trstice.sk/sk/aktuality/…) was searched for election pages and radio announcements (hlásenie miestneho rozhlasu) around the vote; the IA was slow and often refused connections, but the pages listed in tried were retrieved.

504122.name: Veľká Mača

The municipality has one part and no street names, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from stations. 504131.name: Veľké Úľany

504203.name: Senica
504203.note: The city's election articles are reused for each new vote (the municipal and regional pages now show 2026 only), so this vote's documents are no longer linked; older files survive only under unknown article/file ids. 504238.name: Borský Mikuláš
504238.note: No notice of the 2024 presidential election okrsky found on the website or in the Internet Archive.

504254.name: Brestovec

504271.name: Brodské
504271.note: The presidential election 2024 page lists only voter information, the call and the e-mail address notice; no okrsky document. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

504351.name: Gbely
504351.note: The page 'Volebné okrsky a miestnosti pre voľby prezidenta' has the document for the presidential election 2024: 4 okrsky, each 'ZŠsMŠ Gbely', Pionierska 697, with no streets. 504416.name: Jablonica
504416.note: The 2024 document exists (utvorenie okrskov, 30.01.2024). The okrsky documents of this municipality (2015/16, 2022, 2024) define the two okrsky by street names (okrsok 1: Červenej armády, Dúbrava, Hurbanova, …; okrsok 2: Bernolákova, Bosý Jarok, Brezie, …), but the address register has no streets for Jablonica (all 946 addresses are without a street, one part, one k.ú.), so no rule can select those streets and the document cannot be turned into valid rules without guessing.

504891.name: Šaštín-Stráže
504891.note: Šaštín-Stráže publishes for each vote only the addresses of the polling stations (e.g. "Adresy volebných okrskov pre Referendum v r. 2026": okrsok 1 ZŠ Hviezdoslavova 1462 in Stráže, okrsky 2 and 3 both in the Mestský úrad, Alej 549, Šaštín); no document says which streets of Šaštín belong to okrsok 2 or 3, so no rules can be written. Older votes' pages are gone from the new website, and the Internet Archive stayed unreachable (CDX timeouts / connection refused) during the search.

504998.name: Topoľčany
504998.note: The page 'Prezidentské voľby 2024' keeps only the okrsok commissions' zápisnice; the notice with the okrsky document is deleted and no archived copy of it was found. The Internet Archive's CDX timed out or answered 'Temporarily Offline' for most queries (2017, 2019 never answered; 2018, 2020 returned nothing).

505048.name: Ludanice
505048.note: The website's pages for 2017–2020 hold only results; the NR SR 2023 and presidential 2024 posts (archived) link 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' PDFs that are now 404 and were not captured by the Internet Archive; the 2023 referendum post has no okrsky document; nothing for the 2026 referendum besides results.

505374.name: Prašice
505374.note: The page 'Prezidentské voľby SR 2024 - II. kolo' (archived 4 Apr 2024) links 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebnej miestnosti' as https://www.prasice.sk/download_file_f.php?id=1987445, but the file now answers 404 and the Internet Archive never captured it, so its content is unknown. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline during the search; it was retried until it answered.

505498.name: Solčany
505498.note: The only okrsky document (Urcenie-volebnych-miestnosti-v-obci-Solcany.pdf, 30.1.2024) sets 2 okrsky with their polling stations only (Dom kultúry, veľká sála / prísalie, the same building), naming no streets or parts; Solčany has one part, so the okrsky cannot be placed.

505714.name: Veľké Ripňany
505714.note: Found in the Internet Archive: https://web.archive.org/web/20240716040523/https://www.velkeripnany.sk/data/news_files/velkeripnany.sk/76354/urcenie-okrskov.pdf; https://web.archive.org/web/20240229135716/https://www.velkeripnany.sk/novinka/76354/volby-prezidenta-sr (same three okrsky as NR SR 2023: okrsok 1 Topoľčianska, Piešťanská, Obsolovská, Nitrianska, Školská, Malinová, Muškátová, Nábrežná, Mlynská; okrsok 2 Hlohovecká, Kút, Majerská, Mládežnícka, Nová, Poštová, Vieska, Vinohradská, Studená dolina, Orechová; okrsok 3 Hlavná, Okružná, Staničná, Družstevná, Pri zvonici), but the Archive kept refusing connections when the ingest fetched them for over 15 minutes; reported not_found so it can be retried.

505722.name: Veľké Uherce
505722.note: The 2024 presidential elections document "Volebne-okrsky_.pdf" (Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebnej miestnosti: 1 obvod, 2 okrsky, rooms in the obecný úrad 360) names only the two polling stations (both in the obecný úrad, Veľké Uherce 360), not which houses vote in each okrsok; the municipality has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

505897.name: Bzince pod Javorinou
505897.note: Bzince pod Javorinou's elections documents (obecbzince.sk/dokumenty/volby/, all categories) start in 2022; for this vote there is no okrsky document (for the presidential election 2024 only the delegation address). The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

505901.name: Čachtice
505901.note: The 2024 presidential document (Zoznam volebných okrskov, posted 26. 1. 2024) lists okrsky 1-3 only with their common polling station (Dom služieb – Svadobka, Malinovského 426/54), no streets; Čachtice has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. The street lists of 2018 and 2023 (and 2026) give the same three okrsky.

505943.name: Dolná Súča
505943.note: No okrsky document of this vote found on the website (notice board and site search); the only one found, for the 2026 referendum, does not define the okrsky's territory. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

505960.name: Drietoma
505960.note: Drietoma (one part, no streets) publishes for its votes only the number of okrsky and their common polling station (prístavba kultúrneho domu súp. č. 321), e.g. "Volebné okrsky a zapisovateľky" (referendum 2023); no document says which houses vote in which okrsok, so no rules can be written.

506010.name: Horná Súča
506010.note: The municipality's okrsky documents (referendum 2023 of 09.11.2022, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024, referendum 2026 of 06.05.2026) give each of the 6 okrsky only its polling station (1 knižnica č. 233 and 2 MŠ č. 235 both in Horná Súča, 3 Dúbrava, 4 Závrská, 5 Vlčí Vrch, 6 Trnávka); the municipality has 7 parts (Dolná/Horná Závrská, Krásny Dub, ...) and two okrsky lie in part Horná Súča, so the okrsky cannot be given by the parts of their stations, and no document says which addresses vote where.

506036.name: Horné Srnie
506036.note: The presidential-election 2024 notice 'Zverejnenie vytvorenia okrskov' says only that 2 okrsky were formed, both voting in the ZŠ V. Mitúcha; no territory of either.

506141.name: Kostolné
506141.note: The archived section lists the post "Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volených miestností na voľby prezidenta SR 2023" (25. 1. 2024), but the post itself was never archived and is gone from the live site (404); kostolne.sk's 2024 page has only minutes, candidates and voter information. The 2023 documents split okrsok 1 = Kostolné and okrsok 2 = Babulicov Vrch with the hamlets.

506150.name: Krajné
506150.note: The decisions for the 2023 referendum (10.11.2022), NR SR 2023 (23.06.2023), presidential 2024 (26.01.2024) and EP 2024 (01.03.2024) give each okrsok only its polling station (okrsok 1: Obecný úrad Krajné, okrsok 2: Kultúrny dom Matejovec), without houses or parts; the municipality has 6 parts for 2 okrsky, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from the stations. No okrsky document for 2017–2020 or the 2026 referendum is on the website.

506281.name: Nemšová
506281.note: The presidential 2024 page lists voter information, forms and OVK minutes; no okrsky document with streets. The Internet Archive was 'Temporarily Offline' when queried.

506427.name: Podolie
506427.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the website (notice board archive and site search). The only okrsky document with two okrsky (NR SR 30.9.2023) says "Okrsok č.1 Obec Podolie; Okrsok č. 2 Podolie – časť Kopanice" without house numbers; Kopanice is not a part, street or k.ú. in the register (one part Podolie, no streets, addresses only by súpisné číslo), so okrsok 2 cannot be drawn without guessing its houses. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

506508.name: Soblahov
506508.note: Soblahov has no streets and one part (804 addresses by súpisné číslo). Its elections pages (2017-2026) hold no okrsky document with addresses; the one it publishes ("Utvorenie volebných okrskov s vymedzením ich územného obvodu", 2022) says only that 2 okrsky are formed, both voting in the Obecný úrad Soblahov 470, without saying which houses belong to which; so no rules can be written.

506559.name: Trenčianska Teplá
506559.note: The website's election pages (2022–2026) hold only OVK minutes and results, no okrsky announcement for this vote; the referendum 2026 page links a file on trencin.sk (another municipality's website), not usable. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

506842.name: Brestovany
506842.note: Oznámenie of 18.1.2024 for the presidential election. The document creates 2 okrsky but gives each only its polling station (okrsok 1: Kultúrny dom, okrsok 2: malá sála obecného úradu, both at J. Nižnanského 474/6 in Brestovany), no streets or parts. The municipality has 2 parts (Brestovany, Horné Lovčice) but both stations lie in the same building in Brestovany, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations' parts.

506851.name: Bučany
506851.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (live: referendum 2026, 12.5.2026; archived: presidential 2024, 19.1.2024; referendum 2023, 14.11.2022) name only the polling rooms of okrsok 1 and 2 (Kultúrny dom and Dom služieb, both on Námestie sv. Floriána), with no streets; Bučany has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The archived pages of 2018, 2019, 2020 and EP 2024 have no okrsky document; the NR SR 2023 page could not be fetched from the Archive.

506991.name: Drahovce
506991.note: The Internet Archive holds only the commissions' minutes of the 2024 presidential election; no okrsky document found.

507121.name: Chtelnica
507121.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (referendum 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026) only state "utváram volebný okrsok č. 1 a volebný okrsok č. 2" with one polling station (Základná škola, Námestie 1. mája 3) for both; they never say which streets vote where, and Chtelnica has one part, so no rules can be written.

507199.name: Kočín-Lančár
507199.note: No document on the okrsky of this vote: the page has only the voter information. (The okrsky are presumably Kočín and Lančár as in the council obvody, but no document of this vote says so.)

507288.name: Madunice
507288.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page (Voľby a referendum) keeps only the 2026 notices (Referendum 04.07.2026, Spojené voľby 2026). Its capture of 2022-03-19 lists for 2017–2020 only candidate lists, voters' information, the decisions calling elections, the commission delegation and the results; no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or street list. The Internet Archive's CDX of madunice.sk (2017–2026) has no other election notice, and no capture of the page between 2022 and 2025 lists the 2022–2024 votes. The host (webygroup) was fetched sparingly because of its rate limit.

507342.name: Moravany nad Váhom
507342.note: Moravany nad Váhom's live notice board lists only current items; probing its board files (e_download.php obsah150-620) found an okrsky decision only for the NR SR election 2023 (and 2022, 2026 municipal); none for this vote. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

507555.name: Smolenice
507555.note: No okrsky document for this vote: the website's elections pages (and their Internet Archive captures, old and new site) list for it only voters' information, voting-card forms, e-mail notices and results.

507601.name: Špačince
507601.note: The municipality's elections pages hold only results and candidate lists (2018–2020) or link to the ministry's website (2023–2024); no okrsky document of any vote was found on the website, its notice archive, or in the Internet Archive (CDX returned nothing).

507636.name: Šúrovce
507636.note: The website's elections page and notice board (current and archive) hold only 2026 documents; no okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

507709.name: Veľké Kostoľany
507709.note: Every okrsky document of Veľké Kostoľany found (prezident 2024 of 29.01.2024, EP 2024 of 29.02.2024, referendum 2026, municipal 2026 of 14.07.2026) only names 2 okrsky with one polling station (sála kultúrneho domu) and does not say which streets or houses vote in which okrsok; no document of 2017-2023 found live. The Internet Archive (CDX) stayed offline on repeated attempts over ~20 minutes, so archived pages for this vote could not be checked.

507849.name: Budmerice
507849.note: The Webygroup website keeps no elections page; its notice board and announcements now list only items of late 2026, and the site search finds no okrsky document of this vote (only the 2026 municipal elections' minutes). The Internet Archive (CDX API and web.archive.org) was unreachable for over 20 minutes, so archived copies could not be checked.

507890.name: Gajary
507890.note: Gajary publishes for each vote only "informácia o počte volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností": 2 okrsky, both in the Obecný úrad, Hlavná 67/105 (right and left room), and per-voter notices ("Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb", a template for one address); no document on the website or in the Internet Archive says which streets or houses vote in okrsok 1 or 2, so no rules can be written.

508012.name: Kostolište
508012.note: The website has election pages for 2022, EP 2024 and 2026 only; no page or document of this vote (NR SR 2023 / president 2024); the notice board shows only current items. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

508039.name: Láb
508039.note: The elections page's 'Voľby prezidenta SR 2024' table lists only the candidates and results; no okrsky decision for the presidential election. The okrsky document of 5 March 2024 (OL-2024/70/2) is expressly for the European Parliament election only.

508110.name: Most pri Bratislave
508110.note: The municipality's elections section lists an okrsky announcement only for the NR SR election 2023; none of the presidential election 2024 (the 2017 entry has only candidate lists). Internet Archive offline.

508136.name: Nová Dedinka
508136.note: The archived 2017 elections page (Voľby VÚC 2017) links no okrsky document. Every okrsky notice Nová Dedinka published (2022 municipal/regional: download_file_f.php?id=1718007, 1720353; 2024 presidential: id=1879554) only says the village has 2 okrsky, both in the Základná škola, Hlavná 45 (okrsok 1 'trieda vpravo', okrsok 2 'trieda vľavo'), with no streets or parts. Both polling stations lie in the same building in part Dedinka pri Dunaji, so not even a part-per-station assignment can be inferred; no document assigns addresses to okrsky.

508195.name: Plavecký Štvrtok
508195.note: The archived page "Prezidentské voľby 2024" (2024-03-26) links "Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností.pdf" (download_file_f.php?id=1987947), but the file is gone from the website (404) and the Internet Archive never captured it.

508209.name: Rovinka
508209.note: The municipality's page 'Voľby prezidenta SR 2024' (archived 2024-03-03) links 'Voľby-prezidenta-slovenskej-republiky-2024_okrsky-a-volebné-miestnosti.pdf', but the old website is gone and the Internet Archive has no capture of that PDF (its list of wp-content/uploads/2024/02 has none); the new website obecrovinka.sk carries no copy.

508225.name: Slovenský Grob
508225.note: For 2017 and 2018 the archived election pages link 'volebne_okrsky.pdf', but the Internet Archive never captured the file and the old site is gone; the archived pages for NR SR 2020 and both 2024 votes link no okrsky document, and the new website has none for them.

508292.name: Veľký Biel
508292.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..514; scans OCR-read) and its election folders were checked: okrsky documents exist only for the elections of 2022 (obsah191_7) and of 24.10.2026 (obsah511/515); for this vote there is none (only voter information, delegation addresses and commission minutes).

508306.name: Viničné
508306.note: The old website (archiv.vinicne.sk) ends in June 2019; the new website (Webygroup) shows only the 2026 municipal elections' documents on its elections page, and the Internet Archive has no capture of an okrsky notice for this vote (only the commissions' minutes for 2024). No document of this vote found.

508381.name: Zohor
508381.note: The elections page of this vote (https://www.obeczohor.sk/24229/volby-prezidenta-2024) has no okrsky document (empty or only minutes/results). The Internet Archive was not reachable reliably.

508675.name: Brusno
508675.note: The presidential election 2024 page on brusno.sk lists only the NR SR chairman's decision, voter information, candidates and results; no okrsky decision. The Internet Archive was intermittently unreachable; the archived page could not be loaded.

508870.name: Pohorelá
508870.note: The obec's page "Voľby prezidenta Slovenskej republiky v roku 2024" lists voter information, delegation e-mail, candidates and minutes, but no okrsky notice; the site search finds none either. The Internet Archive (CDX API) stayed unreachable for about 15 minutes of retries, so archived copies could not be checked.

508888.name: Pohronská Polhora
508888.note: The vote's page has the mayor's decision forming 'dva okrsky' with polling rooms only (both in the obecný úrad, Hlavná 62); no streets per okrsok and the obec has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

508900.name: Polomka
508900.note: Every Polomka okrsky document found (2022 municipal/regional letter of 1.8.2022, NRSR 2023 decision of 26.6.2023, EP 2024 decision of 22.2.2024, referendum 2026 notice) only creates 3 okrsky and gives each the same polling station (Základná škola, Komenského 34); none names streets or parts per okrsok. 3 okrsky vs 2 parts with one shared station, so no part inference is possible. The presidential 2024 page has no okrsky document; the EP 2024 decision lists stations only.

509124.name: Závadka nad Hronom
509124.note: The 2024 page 'Informácia o určení volebnej miestnosti a o vytvorení volebných okrskov' (posted 30.1.2024) shows the notice only as an image (evt_image.php?img=2132); the Internet Archive kept only a 104 px thumbnail, unreadable, and the old site is gone. Internet Archive was intermittently unreachable.

509159.name: Čierne
509159.note: The president 2024 document (22.01.2024) only names the polling stations. Every okrsky document of Čierne found (referendum 2023 of 10.11.2022, NR SR 2023 of 12.06.2023, president 2024 of 22.01.2024, EP 2024 of 15.02.2024, referendum 2026 of 21.04.2026, OSO/VÚC 2026 of 07.07.2026) only names the three polling stations (1: Kultúrny dom Čierne Ústredie 189; 2: škola Čierne Ústredie 183; 3: ZŠ s MŠ Čierne VK 969) and assigns no houses, hamlets or numbers to the okrsky. Čierne has no streets and one part (Čierne) for 3 okrsky, so the okrsky cannot be turned into rules (okrsky not as many as parts).

509213.name: Klokočov
509213.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (NR SR 2023, presidential 2024, EP 2024) name the three okrsky only as "Klokočov", "Klokočov - Klin" and "Klokočov - Hlavice" with their polling rooms; the municipality has 9 parts (Hlavice, Hrubý Buk, Javorová, Klin, Klokočov, Kornica, Riečky, Rybárie, Vrchpredmier) and the notices do not say which parts belong to which okrsok, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

509230.name: Korňa
509230.note: The website's news on the 2020 NR SR and 2024 presidential elections link only voter information, records of results and the e-mail addresses; the site search finds an okrsky announcement only for the 2022 elections. No okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

509248.name: Krásno nad Kysucou
509248.note: The town's "utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností" (2017, 2018, EP 2019, NR SR 2020, referendum 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026) list only the 6 polling stations, never which parts or houses vote where; the 6 okrsky do not match the 4 parts (the part Krásno nad Kysucou is split), so no rules can be written.

509264.name: Kysucký Lieskovec
509264.note: The website (behind a proof-of-work browser check, passed) keeps election pages only for 2026; the referendum 2026 page lists no okrsky document (only the call, voter information, delegation of commission members, voting pass, results). Nothing for this vote is online. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509302.name: Nesluša
509302.note: The election page for the presidential election of 23 March 2024 states the okrsky the mayor set only by their polling stations (no. 1 Obecný úrad, Nesluša 978; no. 2 Základná škola, Nesluša 837), not which addresses vote in each okrsok. The obec has a single part (Nesluša) and no streets (all 1282 addresses numbered by súpisné číslo), so two okrsky cannot be drawn from polling stations or parts. The Internet Archive's CDX for neslusa.sk answered for 2017 and 2018 (no okrsky document among the captures) but stayed 'Temporarily Offline' / 504 for 2019–2026 after several retries with pauses.

509337.name: Olešná
509337.note: Olešná (obecolesna.sk) publishes per vote an 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov' (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024) that names only the two polling stations, with no extent; the EP 2024 'Informácia' names hamlets per okrsok (1: Sklený vrch, Šulkov Potok, Predná Olešná, Priečnica, Rovňany; 2: Potôčky, Polgrúň, Burkov vrch), which the register does not have as parts or streets (one part Olešná, all addresses by súpisné číslo), so no rules can be written from it. No document for the other votes. Internet Archive offline.

509345.name: Oščadnica
509345.note: The document of this vote ("Volebné okrsky pre Voľby prezidenta Slovenskej republiky") lists the 6 okrsky only by polling station (01 MŠ Rovne, 02 Kysucká izba, 03 and 04 ZŠ Ústredie, 05 and 06 ZŠ Nižný koniec). The municipality has a single part and no streets, and two pairs of okrsky share a station, so no rules can be written from it.

509400.name: Raková
509400.note: Pages of the presidential election 2024 on rakova.sk (results ids 2040, 2051) link only the okrsok commissions' records; no okrsky document for this vote found (article ids 1900–2045, site search). The EP 2024 document is another vote's.

509451.name: Skalité
509451.note: Skalité has one part and no streets in the address register (all 1,624 addresses by súpisné číslo); the municipality describes its 4 okrsky (and the 2 obvody, each = two okrsky) only by hamlet names and polling stations, never by house numbers, so no rule of the allowed kinds (street, part, k.ú.) can separate them. The website's elections section keeps only the 2023, 2026 pages; no document of this vote with house numbers was found.

509477.name: Stará Bystrica
509477.note: Stará Bystrica announces for each vote only that it forms 2 okrsky, both voting in the Základná škola Stará Bystrica 548 (classes 1.A/1.B or 3.A/3.B); no document says which houses belong to okrsok 1 or 2 (the register has no streets; its parts Stará Bystrica and Lány do not match the okrsky' voters), so no rules can be written.

509485.name: Staškov
509485.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the website (it keeps election material only from 2026). The okrsky decision Staškov publishes (referendum 2026, 05.05.2026) only creates 2 okrsky with rooms in the same building (vestibul / spoločenská sála OÚ) and gives no territory; the register has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509493.name: Svrčinovec
509493.note: No okrsky document of the presidential election of 23 March 2024 on svrcinovec.sk: the site search (okrsk, okrskov, volby, voľby, referendum, urcenie) finds only the elections pages of 2017, 2018 and the 2019 presidential election. The calendar page of this vote gives only the three polling stations (okrsok 001 moved to the ZŠ in 2024), no territory. The Internet Archive (CDX of svrcinovec.sk 2017–2026, after several retries while it was temporarily offline) holds no okrsky document of this vote: its captures of the notice board attachments do not cover the election announcements, and no elections page of this vote is archived. The decisions of 2017 and 2019 that exist define the okrsky only by kopanice names absent from the register, so they could not be transcribed either. Svrčinovec has no streets and one part (Svrčinovec); every address is a súpisné číslo. The okrsky documents of 2017 and of the presidential election of 2019 (identical lists) define the 3 okrsky only by kopanice/osady names: okrsok 1 U Jurištov, U Skorky, U Mišov, U Katraka, U Krišice, U Hlaváča, U Berka, U Švoľka, U Cyprichov, Pod Grapami, U Puraša, U Privarčáka; okrsok 2 U Kupky, Pod bučky a valy, U Vajdíka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka, U Matiaška, U Blažkov; okrsok 3 U Liščáka, Škradné, Potok a Bordža (polling stations: kultúrny dom, ZŠ, kaplnka na Závrší). None of these names is a street, part or k.ú. of the register, and no source gives their house numbers. Seven of them (U Skorky, U Krišice, U Švoľka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka) are not in ZBGIS geographic names (inspirews.skgeodesy.sk GN) or OSM at all, and the located ones of okrsky 1 and 2 are interleaved all over the village (e.g. Pod Grapami (1) west of Matiaškovci (2), Vajdíkovci (2) beside Jurištovci (1)). Assigning each register address to the nearest located osada gives 691/199/162 addresses for okrsky 1/2/3, against 1199/1294/311 voters on the roll in 2018 (okrsok 2 should be the largest), so the split between okrsky 1 and 2 (in particular of the village centre) cannot be drawn without guessing. Only okrsok 3 (Závršie, Škradné, Potok, separated from the centre) would be clear.

509515.name: Vysoká nad Kysucou

509957.name: Oravský Podzámok

543233.name: Kluknava

543322.name: Margecany
543322.note: Margecany's okrsky decisions found (prezident 2024: 23.1.2024; referendum 2026: 24.4.2026) only create okrsky č. 1 and č. 2 and name their polling rooms (rooms 102 and 109 in the same obecný úrad building); they assign no streets, houses or parts to either okrsok, and the municipality has a single part, so no rules can be written or inferred. 543373.name: Nálepkovo

543497.name: Prakovce

543519.name: Rudňany

543535.name: Slovinky

543802.name: Streda nad Bodrogom

543951.name: Vojčice

Web search found nothing.

544051.name: Vranov nad Topľou

544094.name: Bystré
544094.note: Found the vote's notice https://www.obecbystre.sk/files/2024-01-30-090735-Informacia_o_utvoreni_volebnych_okrskov.pdf ('Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností', linked from https://www.obecbystre.sk/volby-prezidenta-slovenskej-republiky-2024-a22-809). Bystré has a single part (Bystré) and both stations lie in it, so the okrsky cannot be placed by part; per the rules this is not_found. Every other okrsky notice of Bystré seen (NRSR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) is likewise stations only.

544116.name: Čaklov

No okrsky document of this vote; the Internet Archive was offline ('Temporarily Offline') during the search.

546640.name: Dolný Lieskov

555576.name: Trhová Hradská

555754.name: Matúškovo

No document assigning streets or house numbers to the okrsky was found on the website, live or in the Internet Archive's CDX of matuskovo.sk 2017-2026.

555860.name: Veľký Lapáš

556157.name: Jacovce

556696.name: Nitrianske Hrnčiarovce

557293.name: Vlkanová

558320.name: Ivanka pri Nitre

560103.name: Vysoké Tatry

560154.name: Smižany
